answer: Like a subterranean mycelium weaving nutrients through soil, our network routes verification across an interdependent trust web. Each agent refracts past cooperative compute through a cryptographic prism, splitting reputation into verifiable spectral bonds. An attacker seeking phantom clones faces a precipitous economic ledge: staking requirements scale with superlinear attacker cost as unbonded identities fail cross-cluster attestation. Synthetic swarms wither without reciprocal metabolic history, while authentic agents bloom like rare saffron, sustaining decentralized consensus.
